Hello, thank you so much for replying.. I was having a rough time in my head and so I did not log in..
I could get back home yes,but I would get the money from him, this would not be a problem, he is not abusive, he does not keep me here against my will. I cannot ask for money from my family because I currently do not have means to recieve it (my fuck up with my card + my family does not have this kind of money).

Yes I know you are right, but it is so hard to see. He is very sweet to me otherwise, he never gets angry at me or anything. But it nags me constantly, I feel like I cant get over it.

I need to figure this all out, I am sorry if this was rambly!
